readout_other: social preference-avoidance and social interaction tests; elevated plus maze; sucrose preference; fiber photometry GCaMP6m calcium imaging of mPFC excitatory neurons; Iba1 immunostaining; western blot (TLR4, NF-kB, TNF-alpha, BDNF, NR2B, PSD95); serum corticosterone ELISA
direction_notes: Acute LIFUS raised mPFC excitatory neuron GCaMP fluorescence during sonication; chronic LIFUS (with stress exposure) gradually reduced social avoidance, enhanced neuronal responses during social interaction and reduced microglial activation and TLR4/NF-kB expression.

exposures.label: chronic LIFUS to mPFC (PrL) in socially defeated mice

timing.protocol_description: 0.5 MHz, 1.5 kHz PRF, 50 cycles (0.1 ms tone burst), 0.5 s sonication duration, 2 s interstimulation interval, Ispta 15 mW/cm2; 15 min per day under isoflurane, delivered 5 h after stress exposure on the first 10 days and continued for 3 further weeks. Sham: transducer 5 cm from the head.

source_quotes.n_subjects: (ii) mice were exposed to SDS, followed by LIFUS stimulation (FUS group, n 17)
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: The mice in the SDS group received daily LIFUS stimulation (see Section 2.6), 15 min per day, for 31 days (10 days 3 weeks)

flags.reason: Only the FUS group (n = 17) received ultrasound; 62 C57BL/6J mice were used in total including controls, and some analyses use subsets (e.g. n = 4 per group for photometry).
Text says LIFUS was daily for 31 days written as '10 days + 3 weeks' (symbol lost in extraction); 31 recorded as stated.
15 mW/cm2 converted to W/cm2; domain not stated (attenuation through skull to about 47.76% was measured separately, no in-situ value given).
Acute photometry during-LIFUS recordings are described over a 13-min stimulation period; the 0.5 s per-sonication value from the chronic parameters is recorded.
Target described as the PrL area of the mPFC, mapped to ventromedial_prefrontal_cortex via the mPFC synonym.
